title: Gifts of the Spirit
definition: Gifts of the Spirit are abilities, ministries, and graces given by God for the building up of the church, the service of others, and the glory of Christ.
summary: Spiritual gifts are not for pride, performance, or division. They are given by grace, exercised in love, and tested by faithfulness to Scripture and the exaltation of Christ.
christFocus: Every true gift should serve the body and point people to Jesus. The greatest measure is not display, but love, edification, and submission to Christ.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Gifts are distributed by God according to His wisdom.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Gifts are for service and edification, not self-exaltation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Love governs the use of every gift.
